name: appfigures/cli
what_it_holds: Official Appfigures CLI and MCP server (Apache-2.0, 20 stars, updated 2 Sep 2026) for pulling sales/rank/review data from the Appfigures API for apps you (or a free-tier account) have access to.
why_useful: Official, maintained client for Appfigures -- the vendor named directly in our gap list -- but almost certainly requires an Appfigures account/API key, and free-tier access is normally limited to apps you own (i.e. would not give third-party Airbnb download data without a paid plan). Worth flagging as the correct tool if the team ever gets/considers an Appfigures trial key, but not usable as-is without one.
themes: App download and ranking histories: App Store / Google Play rank scrapers, app-store-scraper, google-play-scraper, AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples, app review-count time series
why_all: Official, maintained client for Appfigures -- the vendor named directly in our gap list -- but almost certainly requires an Appfigures account/API key, and free-tier access is normally limited to apps you own (i.e. would not give third-party Airbnb download data without a paid plan). Worth flagging as the correct tool if the team ever gets/considers an Appfigures trial key, but not usable as-is without one.

Would be the highest-fidelity route to real historical App Store/Play Store rank curves for Airbnb, but Appfigures requires a paid API key/subscription — out of bounds under this repo's 'never use paid API keys' rule. Catalogued only as a method for a human to consider licensing later.

name: sensortowerR
what_it_holds: R interface (custom/other license, 6 stars, updated 13 May 2026) to the official (paid) Sensor Tower API, covering downloads, revenue, and rank endpoints.
why_useful: Confirms Sensor Tower has an R client, but the underlying API is paid/keyed -- not usable without a Sensor Tower subscription, so low value unless the team already has or can trial API access.
themes: App download and ranking histories: App Store / Google Play rank scrapers, app-store-scraper, google-play-scraper, AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples, app review-count time series
why_all: Confirms Sensor Tower has an R client, but the underlying API is paid/keyed -- not usable without a Sensor Tower subscription, so low value unless the team already has or can trial API access.

name: sensortower-mcp
what_it_holds: MCP server (no listed license, 17 stars, updated 2 Jul 2026) exposing Sensor Tower's official (paid) API endpoints as tools for an LLM agent.
why_useful: Same caveat as the R client -- convenient wrapper but gated behind a paid Sensor Tower key; only useful if the team obtains one.

why_all: Same caveat as the R client -- convenient wrapper but gated behind a paid Sensor Tower key; only useful if the team obtains one.

name: app-store-scraper (review scraper)
what_it_holds: Single-API App Store review scraper (MIT, 102 stars, updated 16 Jul 2026); pulls per-app review text, rating, and timestamps from Apple's storefront.
why_useful: Could be pointed at Airbnb's App Store id to build a review-volume-over-time proxy (a cheap stand-in for review-count time series / app-store review scrapers, gap #14), but overlaps heavily with facundoolano/app-store-scraper's review endpoint.
time_coverage: snapshot of currently-visible reviews only (Apple does not expose full historical review archives)
themes: App download and ranking histories: App Store / Google Play rank scrapers, app-store-scraper, google-play-scraper, AppFigures/Sensor Tower/data.ai open samples, app review-count time series
why_all: Could be pointed at Airbnb's App Store id to build a review-volume-over-time proxy (a cheap stand-in for review-count time series / app-store review scrapers, gap #14), but overlaps heavily with facundoolano/app-store-scraper's review endpoint.

name: apple-app-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Apple App Store review scraper with a backoff strategy for rate limiting (MIT, 22 stars, updated 27 Apr 2026); also forked as Dinoxel/apple-app-reviews-scraper (8 stars).
why_useful: Marginal addition to the review-scraper family above; the backoff handling could make a scheduled Airbnb-review-volume pull more reliable, but no new data or method beyond what facundoolano/app-store-scraper offers.
